title: AI confirms a long-suspected limit on quantum computers’ advantages | New Scientist
description: AI-powered proof has rigorously proved that using quantum computers would not have huge advantages for a whole class of mathematical problems, confirming a vastly influential conjecture.
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: A robot has assembled a structure in space for the first time | New Scientist
description: Autonomous in-orbit manufacturing will be key to any future space economy, and researchers have taken the first step with a robot building a radio antenna without astronaut assistance
author: Leah Crane

title: Economics, not climate summits, will dictate the net-zero transition | New Scientist
description: World leaders at COP31 show little enthusiasm for phasing out fossil fuels, but the plummeting costs of renewable energy will be the key factor in how quickly we can rein in global warming
author: Alec Luhn

title: Pink noise played during sleep shows promise for Alzheimer’s memory loss | New Scientist
description: There is some evidence that pink noise signals can boost the brain's ability to clear out waste products. Now there are some indications that this might improve memory performance in people with Alzheimer's
author: Sascha Brodsky

title: A little-known immune condition is being mistaken for food allergies | New Scientist
description: Doctors are calling for greater awareness of eosinophilic oesophagitis, a chronic condition that can cause symptoms similar to anaphylaxis
author: Zesha Saleem

title: Vast data dump from Euclid space telescope reveals stunning galaxies | New Scientist
description: In the latest release of images collected by the Euclid space telescope, there are close-ups of distant galaxies where stars are in the process of forming
author: Matthew Sparkes
